  AGENDA
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  January 13, 2020

11:30 a.m. – Small Executive Conference, 9th Floor

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the December 16, 2019, meeting.

  2. Keyser Marston Associates, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommended payment
  for professional financial analysis of various development projects.

Closed Session - Confidential
  1. Closed session-Confidential-Attorney/Client Privileged; Executive closed session Claims
  Review Committee with Legal Counsel regarding pending litigation pursuant to California
  Government Code §54956.9(d)(2)); Ramon Harrold Claim for damages.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  January 13, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Small Executive Conference on
the 9th floor at 11:35 a.m.:

  Members Present: Yvonne Horton, City Clerk Department
  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Debbie Crenshaw, City Treasurer

  Staff Present:  Roberto Chavez- HUD Program Manager

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of December 16, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Keyser Marston Associates, Inc – Executive session to discuss recommended
  payment for providing professional financial analysis the amount of $2,092.50. Motion
  carried unanimously.

  Closed Session- Confidential
  3. Ramon Harrold vs City of Inglewood- A motion was moved and second to recommend
  settlement on claim for damages.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:53 a.m. Adjournment
